name: Josep Maria Sert

summary.text: Josep Maria Sert i Badia, also quoted as José María Sert, was a Spanish muralist, the son of an affluent textile industry family. He was particularly known for his grisaille style, often in gold and black.
summary.title: Josep Maria Sert
